## Activity

River Outreach recorded 58 captures during December 2018. This provides the activity count for the reporting period and establishes the volume submitted for review. Capture activity was completed at the site and the resulting images were made available for assessment.

The activity level should be considered alongside the image-quality findings below. Any operational matters affecting capture or review should continue to be recorded through the usual local process so that recurring issues can be identified and addressed.

## Image quality

Of the 58 captures, 4 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 6.9. These images could not be used for grading and should be considered when reviewing the overall performance of the service during the month.

The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Consistent recording of these issues will support follow-up and help distinguish isolated image-quality problems from equipment or process concerns.

## Grading

Grading identified 4 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 0, indicating no delay at the midpoint of the reporting period. The referable results should be managed through the established clinical pathway, with follow-up documented in accordance with local arrangements.
